bounty.name: Bounty
bounty.blurb: A quick hunt for coin and experience.

gathering.name: Gathering
gathering.blurb: Bring supplies back to the outpost.

dungeon.name: Dungeon
dungeon.blurb: A delve for the best gear. Bring a tank, a healer and damage.

slay.name: Slay
slay.blurb: Hunt a dangerous pack for experience and gear drops.

escort.name: Escort
escort.blurb: Walk a convoy down a hostile road for gold and standing.

raid.name: Raid
raid.blurb: Two parties and a long road. Bring a roster of six to ten, with tanks, healers and damage.

templates.title: Cull the wolf pack
templates.text: Wolves have been dragging sheep from the northern pastures.

templates.title: Smoke out the kobold tunnels
templates.text: Candle-wielding kobolds keep stealing from the mine road.

templates.title: Chase off the crossroads bandits
templates.text: A gang is taxing every cart that passes the old crossroads.

templates.title: Clear the murloc shallows
templates.text: Gurgling raiders have taken over the fishing pier.

templates.title: Hunt the old boar
templates.text: A tusked terror is rooting up the farmers' turnips.

templates.title: Drive off the gnoll scouts
templates.text: Scouts from the hills are watching the outpost walls.

templates.title: Cut timber in the north woods
templates.text: Straight oaks stand a short march from the outpost.

templates.title: Haul stone from the hillside
templates.text: Loose rock lies below the old quarry cut.

templates.title: Forage the orchard rows
templates.text: Windfalls and wild grain go to waste beyond the fences.

templates.title: Gather wild herbs
templates.text: Green leaf and bitter root grow along the streams.

templates.title: Prospect for iron ore
templates.text: Rusty seams run through the ridge, if you know where to dig.

templates.title: Fargodeep Mine
templates.text: Kobolds have dug too deep and something below is answering. Clear the tunnels and find who is leading them.

templates.title: Hunt for hides
templates.text: Tanners in Goldshire pay well for clean wolf and boar pelts.

templates.title: Slay the stray pack
templates.text: A pack of wolves and spiders has grown bold along the north road.

templates.title: Break the kobold warren
templates.text: Candle-lit tunnels honeycomb the hill. Someone must go in and break them.

templates.title: Guard the dairy wagon
templates.text: The dairy wagon must reach Goldshire before the cream turns.

templates.title: Carry the post to Stormwind road
templates.text: A satchel of letters waits for a steady pair of boots.

templates.title: Break the Defias roadblock
templates.text: A hooded crew is taxing every cart on the Sentinel Hill road.

templates.title: Scatter the coast gnolls
templates.text: Riverpaw packs are raiding the fishermen at the shore.

templates.title: Smash the runaway harvesters
templates.text: The old reaping machines walk the fields without a master.

templates.title: Thin the prairie wolves
templates.text: Flocks are vanishing from the grazing lands.

templates.title: Hunt the goretusk matriarch
templates.text: A tusked sow the size of a wagon guards the barley fields.

templates.title: Silence the Defias enchanters
templates.text: Whispered spells have turned the scarecrows against the farms.

templates.title: Fell timber near Sentinel Hill
templates.text: Sturdy oaks line the hill road, if the road is clear.

templates.title: Quarry stone from the ridge
templates.text: Pale stone sits close to the surface above the reaper fields.

templates.title: Reap the stray grain
templates.text: Whole fields stand unharvested. The reapers will not like it.

templates.title: Pick moonlit herbs
templates.text: Pale blossoms open by the river for an hour after dusk.

templates.title: Skin the plains game
templates.text: Prairie hides are thick and fetch a fair price at the tannery.

templates.title: Dig the surface veins
templates.text: Iron shows in the cliffs where the rain has cut them open.

templates.title: Raze the Defias camp
templates.text: A hidden camp supplies the road raiders. Burn it out.

templates.title: Crush the gnoll warband
templates.text: The Riverpaw warband is gathering for a march on the farms.

templates.title: Topple the harvest engine
templates.text: One great engine drives the reapers. Break it and they fall still.

templates.title: Escort the grain wagon
templates.text: The harvest must reach the granary at Sentinel Hill.

templates.title: Deliver lamp oil to the lighthouse
templates.text: The coast light is running dry and bandits know it.

templates.title: Lay the grave ghouls to rest
templates.text: Graves behind the old hill stand open and empty.

templates.title: Burn the web-choked trail
templates.text: Night web spiders have wrapped the south trail in silk.

templates.title: Drive back the worgen stalkers
templates.text: Howls circle the village walls each night.

templates.title: Topple the skeletal warders
templates.text: Bone sentries march the ruined watch road.

templates.title: Scatter the bone collectors
templates.text: Something is stitching new bodies from old graves.

templates.title: Cut timber from the Twilight Grove
templates.text: Dark pines grow tall and straight, and not alone.

templates.title: Haul stone from the old ruins
templates.text: Fallen walls are free for the taking, if you can take them.

templates.title: Forage the mushroom hollows
templates.text: Pale fungus feeds a village if it is picked in time.

templates.title: Gather nightshade and graveleaf
templates.text: Strong herbs grow where the soil is oldest.

templates.title: Skin the woodland game
templates.text: Thick deer and boar hides come cheap to those who dare the dark.

templates.title: Prospect the buried galleries
templates.text: Deep seams run under the cemetery hill.

templates.title: Clear the crypt of the restless
templates.text: The crypt below the chapel will not stay quiet.

templates.title: Run down the worgen pack
templates.text: The pack has a den in the hollow. End it before the next moon.

templates.title: Break the patchwork hulks
templates.text: Stitched giants lumber through the fog. Bring heavy hands.

templates.title: Guard the lamplighter
templates.text: Someone must light the road lanterns before the fog thickens.

templates.title: Escort the supply caravan to the village
templates.text: Darkshire is running low and the road is long.

templates.title: The cart on the mine road
templates.text: A cart sits abandoned below the Fargodeep road, lantern still lit. The drover is nowhere to be seen.

templates.title: The hollow hill
templates.text: The drover was taken by gnolls, who were paid in lantern oil. Somebody is feeding them from inside the settlement.

templates.title: Lantern in the dark
templates.text: The surveyor knows the mine and will not go down without an escort. Bring her to the Fargodeep entrance and keep her lantern lit.

templates.title: The empty granary
templates.text: The Sentinel Hill granary was emptied overnight, and the doors were never forced.

templates.title: Names in the ledger
templates.text: A stolen ledger lists every farm the road gang will visit next. Take the camp that holds the other half.

templates.title: Lamps for the lighthouse
templates.text: The keeper swears the coast light was put out on purpose. See fresh oil safely to the tower.

templates.title: What the miners left behind
templates.text: A foreman's tally scratched on a wall points down to the Deadmines. Find who is counting.

templates.title: Candles in the windows
templates.text: Every house keeps a candle lit until dawn. Tonight the candles went out one by one.

templates.title: Bones on the Raven Hill road
templates.text: The dead walk the old road in neat lines, as if marching to a roll call.

templates.title: The night watch
templates.text: The last watchman will hold the gate if someone brings him fresh oil and a steady companion.

templates.title: Darkshire holds
templates.text: The pack has come down from the hills and will not stop at the walls. Hold the gate until morning.

templates.title: The Deadmines
templates.text: The Defias have dug a fortress under the old gold mine. Their leader keeps the ledger, the ogre smith and a goblin shredder.

templates.label: World boss
templates.title: Stitches, the Patchwork Terror
templates.text: A stitched giant walks the Duskwood road each night. It will not stop until someone puts it down for good.

mechanics.name: Stitches sheds a limb that walks

templates.title: Hunt the jungle panthers
templates.text: The panthers have found that carts are slow and drivers are tasty.

templates.title: Thin the raptor nests
templates.text: Eggs, claws and a great deal of noise beside the river.

templates.title: Drive off the gorilla troop
templates.text: They have taken the lumber road as their own.

templates.title: Break the Bloodscalp raiders
templates.text: A war party waits where the trail meets the water.

templates.title: Chase off the buccaneers
templates.text: Pirates from the bay want a toll, paid in your purse.

templates.title: Fell ironwood in the Vale
templates.text: Ironwood is dense, dark and very much worth the trouble.

templates.title: Quarry the ruin stones
templates.text: Old troll masonry makes fine foundations, if the ghosts agree.

templates.title: Gather fruit along the river
templates.text: Mangoes the size of a fist, guarded by things the size of a cart.

templates.title: Pick herbs in the jungle canopy
templates.text: Rare blooms grow where the light is poor and the snakes are rich.

templates.title: Skin the great panthers
templates.text: Prime hides, if you can bring them back unbitten.

templates.title: Prospect the Bloodscalp hills
templates.text: Iron lies in veins right beside the troll camps.

templates.title: Storm a Bloodscalp camp
templates.text: The drums have not stopped for two days.

templates.title: Clear the buccaneer cove
templates.text: Smugglers hold a cove and everything in it, including the good rum.

templates.title: Purge the Gurubashi ruins
templates.text: The old stones are alive with berserkers who have never heard of peace.

templates.title: Walk the Booty Bay road
templates.text: A merchant wants his goods at the bay before the tide turns.

templates.title: Guard the Vale expedition
templates.text: Scholars with shovels are headed for the ruins. Somebody must make sure they come out.

templates.title: Drums in the green
templates.text: Every night the jungle drums grow louder. The Vale holds its breath.

templates.title: The blood priests
templates.text: Hakkari priests have been seen among the Gurubashi, painting signs on every stone.

templates.title: The scholar of the Vale
templates.text: A map of the ruins is worth a great deal, and so is the woman who drew it.

templates.title: Before the gates of Zul'Gurub
templates.text: The troll city is waking. Cut down what stands between you and its gate.

templates.title: Zul'Gurub
templates.text: A lost city of trolls, and in it a god of blood that was not meant to wake. Bring a whole roster.
templates.label: Raid

templates.title: Hunt the crocolisks
templates.text: They have started to take cattle, then carts.

templates.title: Lay the mire wraiths to rest
templates.text: Pale lights over the water lead travellers to the deep mud.

templates.title: Drive off the bog ogres
templates.text: They have claimed the only dry road for a toll of two bucklers.

templates.title: Cull the emerald whelps
templates.text: A nest by the temple wall has grown very restless.

templates.title: Scatter the Atal'ai scouts
templates.text: They watch the marsh road and report to something below.

templates.title: Cut mangrove in the Sorrows
templates.text: Waterlogged but plentiful, and the crocolisks know it.

templates.title: Dredge stones from the shallows
templates.text: The sunken causeway is paved with good, heavy stone.

templates.title: Fish the Sorrows
templates.text: The fish are good. The things that eat them are not.

templates.title: Gather swampbloom
templates.text: A grey herb that grows in the dark and heals in the light.

templates.title: Hunt for drake hide
templates.text: Scaled hides, tough as plate, from drakes that nest in the reeds.

templates.title: Prospect the temple foothills
templates.text: The ore here is dark and heavy, and slightly damp.

templates.title: Burn out the drake nest
templates.text: Eggs, whelps and one very angry mother.

templates.title: Storm the Atal'ai camp
templates.text: Priests of a dead god, sharpening spears by torchlight.

templates.title: Break the ogre hold
templates.text: A mud fort with an unreasonable number of clubs.

templates.title: Lead the pilgrims along the causeway
templates.text: A hundred faithful want to see the temple. Please, let them see it from far away.

templates.title: Carry the relics to the shore
templates.text: A scholar recovered something the swamp wanted back.

templates.title: A temple sinks
templates.text: A great stone building has sunk to its eaves in the mud, and the water around it is warm.

templates.title: The dragon's children
templates.text: Green dragons are guarding something below the temple. They are not guarding it well.

templates.title: Testimony of the last priest
templates.text: One of the Atal'ai wants to talk, and his brothers want him quiet.

templates.title: The temple doors
templates.text: Broken stairs and sealed doors. Cut your way to the first hall.

templates.title: The Temple of Atal'Hakkar
templates.text: A sunken temple and the god of blood below it. The priests are still serving.

templates.title: Clear the scorpid dunes
templates.text: Spines like swords, and they come out of the ash itself.

templates.title: Hunt the searing hounds
templates.text: They follow the heat, and today that means you.

templates.title: Scatter Blackrock outrunners
templates.text: Scouts for an army that has already begun to march.

templates.title: Break the Dark Iron sentries
templates.text: They guard a road with no one on it. That is the worrying part.

templates.title: Shoot down the black drakes
templates.text: They circle over the caravan road, patient as the grave.

templates.title: Cut cinderwood
templates.text: Black timber that burns slow and builds hard.

templates.title: Carry out obsidian
templates.text: Obsidian blocks, and a long way to carry them.

templates.title: Hunt for ash-fed game
templates.text: Lean but plentiful, and fiercely competed for.

templates.title: Gather firebloom
templates.text: A red herb that sits in the cinder like a spark.

templates.title: Skin the steppes scorpids
templates.text: Chitin and leather, hard as plate and half as friendly.

templates.title: Dig dark iron seams
templates.text: The best ore under the sun, and the last of it is still guarded.

templates.title: Raid a Blackrock war camp
templates.text: Orcs in good armour, with a far better plan than yours.

templates.title: Silence the forges
templates.text: A hundred hammers, a hundred guards, one very long night.

templates.title: Fight in the Ring
templates.text: Gladiators who like an audience and have never lost one.

templates.title: Cross the steppes with a caravan
templates.text: The only road runs between two forges. Choose which to be afraid of.

templates.title: Lead the deserters out
templates.text: Dark Iron deserters want to get home. Their own side wants them back.

templates.title: Smoke on the horizon
templates.text: The sky above the steppes has been black for three days, and the wind smells like iron.

templates.title: The war camp
templates.text: Blackrock banners stand in a long, orderly line, as if a parade had been turned into a siege.

templates.title: The pass to the mountain
templates.text: There is one pass left to the Depths, and one friendly guide.

templates.title: Gates of the mountain
templates.text: The great doors are shut and the guards are hot with anger. Go through them.

templates.title: Blackrock Depths
templates.text: A city under a mountain, and a throne of fire at the end. Do not dawdle.

templates.title: Smother the lava spawn
templates.text: They split when struck. Do not strike them badly.

templates.title: Hunt the core hounds
templates.text: Packs of molten dogs, loyal to a fire.

templates.title: Mine the molten seams
templates.text: The hottest ore in the world, if you can carry it.

templates.title: Cut cooled basalt
templates.text: Black basalt from beside the firelands. Quick, before it warms.

templates.title: Gather ember herbs
templates.text: A flower that blooms in the heat of the deep, and wilts in the sun.

templates.title: Storm the core hound lair
templates.text: Every hound in the mountain, and one very large one.

templates.title: Guide the fire pilgrims
templates.text: They seek an audience with a lord who will not be gracious.

templates.title: The firelands stir
templates.text: Rivers of orange cross the black stone. Something large is rising beneath them.

templates.title: The flamewakers
templates.text: Priests in red robes tend the heart of the mountain and sing to it.

templates.title: A message for the Firelord
templates.text: There is a path through the lower halls. One of them has agreed to walk it with you.

templates.title: Ragnaros, the Firelord
templates.text: The master of the Molten Core, and the end of Era 1. Take the best you have.

mechanics.name: The majordomo grows tired of you

templates.label: Era boss

templates.title: Snuff the hellfire imps
templates.text: They are small, they are many, and they are on fire.

templates.title: Hunt the fel hounds
templates.text: Red-eyed and hungry, and they follow the road.

templates.title: Break the Bleeding Hollow patrol
templates.text: Orcs who drank deep, and do not remember why.

templates.title: Mine the Fel-touched seams
templates.text: Dark ore that hums when the wind is wrong.

templates.title: Gather felweed
templates.text: A glowing green weed that grows where nothing else will.

templates.title: Quarry the broken ramparts
templates.text: Ancient stone, scorched and strangely warm.

templates.title: Skin the fel hounds
templates.text: Tough hide, and it keeps a faint green glow.

templates.title: Storm a Legion outpost
templates.text: A watchtower and a lot of very angry guards.

templates.title: Clear the Bleeding Hollow pit
templates.text: Gladiators at the bottom of a hole, and a crowd that wants a show.

templates.title: Guide the Honor Hold supply cart
templates.text: The road from the Hold is long and the cart is slow.

templates.title: Walk the scholars to the Dark Portal
templates.text: They want to see it. You want them back.

templates.title: Red sky over the Peninsula
templates.text: The portal is open and the sky above it is the colour of an old wound.

templates.title: The siege of Honor Hold
templates.text: The Hold has stood for weeks. Help it stand for a few more.

templates.title: The road to the Ramparts
templates.text: There is a fortress at the end of the road, and the only guide is a wounded scout.

templates.label: Era boss
templates.title: Hellfire Ramparts
templates.text: The fortress gate of the Legion in Outland, and the end of Era 2. The chronicle stops here for now.
